page_title: SHU 2-2 WHU | Sheffield Utd v West Ham 21/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+15' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+13' 2 - 2 Goal! Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Alphonse Areola into the bottom left corner.
90+12' David Moyes is forced to make a change. Alphonse Areola (West Ham) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Lukasz Fabianski.
90+11' Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+10' Alphonse Areola (West Ham) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
90+9' Michael Salisbury has a clear sight and sees a foul from Alphonse Areola (West Ham). The referee's verdict is crystal clear. A penalty is awarded to Sheffield Utd!
90+7' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) should have been more careful. He commits a bad foul, receives his second yellow card and is sent-off!
90+6' Today's match ends for Danny Ings who will be replaced by Divin Mubama (West Ham).
90+5' Danny Ings (West Ham) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
90+3' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
90+3' It‘s a RED card, and quite right too after seeing the replay! Referee Michael Salisbury had no choice but to send Rhian Brewster (Sheffield Utd) off. VAR seen to good effect there!

90+3' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Rhian Brewster (Sheffield Utd), but referee Michael Salisbury must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
90+1' Rhian Brewster (Sheffield Utd) takes out his opponent with a horrific tackle and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Here comes a substitution. Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) is brought on as a substitute for Vini Souza.
87' A cross from James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

85' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.
80' Chris Wilder prepares a substitution. Andre Brooks is replaced by Rhian Brewster (Sheffield Utd).
80' Substitution. Rhys Norrington-Davies (Sheffield Utd) in, Auston Trusty out.
79' 1 - 2 GOAL! That’s a perfect strike from the spot by James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) high into the middle of the goal, giving goalkeeper Wesley Foderingham no chance!
79' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

79' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. The referee makes a call and blows his whistle for an infringement. West Ham are awarded a penalty.
77' The attendance is 29164.
75' Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Salisbury had an easy-decision to make.

73' Danny Ings (West Ham) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Wesley Foderingham makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom right corner.
73' Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
70' David Moyes has decided to substitute Maxwel Cornet and he is replaced by Benjamin Johnson (West Ham).
68' Andre Brooks (Sheffield Utd) has tested the patience of referee Michael Salisbury and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
67' Ben Brereton Diaz will be replaced by Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd).

65' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Sheffield Utd are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
61' Andre Brooks (Sheffield Utd) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
61' That's unlucky! Maxwel Cornet (West Ham) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.

58' James McAtee plays a lovely pass into Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.

57' A rebound falls to Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
56' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Maxwel Cornet (West Ham). Sheffield Utd have a free kick from a promising distance.
52' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
52' Sheffield Utd take a short corner kick.
52' Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. Sheffield Utd will take a corner kick.
49' Pablo Fornals (West Ham) tries to find Danny Ings, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.
46' Chris Wilder has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) replacing William Osula.
46' The whistle blows and Michael Salisbury starts the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

45+2' William Osula (Sheffield Utd) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Sheffield Utd.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' 1 - 1 Goal! Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the middle of the net. It's 1:1.

44' What a save from Alphonse Areola! William Osula (Sheffield Utd) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
42' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.

41' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) finds some space to control the ball from the corner and shoots, but his attempt goes way wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.
41' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) prepares to take a corner kick.
40' Danny Ings (West Ham) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
39' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
37' William Osula (Sheffield Utd) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick!
36' James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
35' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alphonse Areola intercepts the ball.
34' Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
28' 0 - 1 Goal! Maxwel Cornet (West Ham) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 0:1.
28' Danny Ings (West Ham) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
28' Auston Trusty (Sheffield Utd) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
27' The ball goes out for a corner. Sheffield Utd can continue in their attacking effort.

27' James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Sheffield Utd force a corner. They send men into the box.

23' A sweet pass finds Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. Alphonse Areola is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
23' Maxwel Cornet (West Ham) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Danny Ings.
22' Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) is flagged for offside after the defenders execute the offside trap perfectly.
21' Pablo Fornals (West Ham) attempts to find Emerson with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
20' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

18' Andre Brooks (Sheffield Utd) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
17' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) takes the free kick from the edge of the box but the defensive wall makes the block.
16' Kurt Zouma (West Ham) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Michael Salisbury signals. Sheffield Utd earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.

14' CHANCE! Danny Ings finds Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the right post! The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.

11' Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Alphonse Areola makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.

9' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.

8' A cross by William Osula (Sheffield Utd) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is behind the touchline and West Ham will take a throw-in.
6' James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
2' Andre Brooks (Sheffield Utd) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. It's a throw-in for Sheffield Utd.
1' The match has just started.
West Ham will kick-off.
Michael Salisbury will referee today's match.
